pathAssistantSteps.info:
Assigned - unit is assigned to a Quote or Opportunity.

  • Soft hold for the linked deal
  • If the deal falls through, return unit to Available

Available - unit is unallocated and ready for sale.

  • Confirm space type, capacity, and power specs are populated
  • Unit is visible in feasibility checks for new Opportunities

Decommissioned - unit returned to pool or retired.

  • Customer contract has ended
  • Verify unit is physically cleared before setting Available
  • Update Breaker Panel and Space ID records

Installed - physical installation complete, customer is live.

  • Customer has physical access
  • Monitor contract end date for renewal

Pending Available - unit is transitioning back to the available pool.

  • Previous customer contract has ended or unit was released
  • Ops to verify unit is physically cleared before marking Available

ROFR - Right of First Refusal active.

  • Existing customer has contractual right to this unit
  • Cannot be sold to another party without offering to ROFR holder first

Reserved - Order confirmed, awaiting provisioning.

  • Unit is hard-allocated to the Order
  • Ops to complete physical provisioning

Sold - unit is contractually committed.

  • Linked to an Order Item
  • Service Commencement Date set
  • Customer billing begins on SCD

Stranded - unit cannot be sold in current state.

  • Physical or infrastructure issue prevents allocation
  • Ops to investigate and resolve before returning to Available
